description: Get a VibeMap project's analytics tracking plan: the product events your code should emit, named to the Segment Spec ("Booking Created", "Page Viewed"). Each event gives its call type (track | page | identify | group), where it fires (`client` = from the UI action, on the listed element keys; `server` = after the database write commits, used for payments, orders and bookings), its trigger, the page and table it belongs to, and typed properties linked to schema columns (PII flagged). Emit events through one vendor-neutral helper such as `analytics.track(name, properties)`; never hard-code a vendor SDK. An empty `events` list means the project has no tracking plan: add no tracking. Read-only.
name: vibemap_get_analytics_plan
